name: Issho ni Massage♪ ~Osananajimi to Imouto to~
original_name: いっしょにマッサージ♪ ～幼馴染と妹と～
source:
One afternoon, the protagonist give his childhood friend, Miharu and his younger sister, Yuzu, separately a massage.

As he gently massages them, they begin to moan faintly. As he massages their sensitive spots, the more they start to moan and gradually they turn to the protagonist with anticipation...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=827264]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
某个午后，主角分别为青梅竹马美春和妹妹柚子按摩。
他轻柔地按摩她们时，两人开始发出细微呻吟。按摩到敏感部位后，她们呻吟得越来越大，渐渐带着期待转向主角……
